- **Archive parent:** Fig Fumb
- **Builder:** Stone Deaf FX
- **Catalog type:** Fuzz
- **Identity:** Stone Deaf FX's Fig Fumb.

Stone Deaf FX's Fig Fumb is cataloged as a fuzz pedal.

- No specific factory colorway information was established in the verified evidence packet.

- The photo review found distinct V1 and V2 product identities in surviving marketplace records. The archive keeps the parent record as **Fig Fumb** but uses a verified V1 photograph for the historical representative image unless a separately versioned catalog entry is created.

- No specific factory version changes were established in the verified evidence packet.

- Exact production transistor/device information was not established in the verified evidence packet.
- **Exact transistor/device:** Unknown.

- Exact production clipping/rectifier diode information was not established in the verified evidence packet.
- **Exact part:** Unknown.

The verified evidence packet did not contain enough pedal-specific sonic description to make a more detailed sound summary without adding unsupported interpretation.

1. Products – Stone Deaf: https://www.stonedeaffx.com/collections/all

- **Archive status:** Exact V1 representative photo selected for the unversioned Fig Fumb record.
- **Photo revision note:** Do not substitute the later V2 enclosure merely because it is easier to source.
- **Photo evidence:** Reverb's exact Fig Fumb product record identifies the model as Fig Fumb V1 and provides the photographed pedal used by the archive's direct-photo lead.
